# ANTLR 2.7.7

`antlr:antlr:2.7.7` is on the desktop app's runtime classpath. Its POM names "BSD License"
with a link to the ANTLR 2 license page; `LICENSE.txt` is that page's text (https://www.antlr2.org/license.html):
public domain, with a fallback grant, and 3-clause BSD for the Python generator code in the jar.
